scope: Source-locked Linux spawn FD fallback: two clean builds per ABI, native Linux vfork/error tests, and unchanged 20-probe application assertions on native arm64 API 28/31/33/35 at 4096 bytes, native x86_64 API 33 at 4096 bytes, and Samsung native arm64 API 36 at 16384 bytes. Not the plugin Binder contract.
sourceBinding: Built from this base plus the exact UTF-8/LF source inputs in the receipt, revalidated after device runs; not attributed to the unmodified base commit.

nativeSourceReview.upstreamEquivalenceScope: all five paths at the five-patch compatibility prefix; later startup and spawn changes explicitly project-owned

hostSpawnFd.cases: FD 256 and 70000 with soft/hard lowered to 128, unchanged large limits, limit 0 controlled EMFILE, parent/fd3 preservation, inclusive mark/close, raw syscall failures, EINTR bounds, malformed records and entry budget.
hostSpawnFd.environment: Digest-locked offline non-root Linux container, read-only root/source, disposable executable tmpfs, nofile=1048576:1048576.
hostSpawnFd.setupNote: Selected installed g++-13/clang++ explicitly; test-only Linux syscall number definition accommodates the old host headers. The symbol gate allows compiler stack-protection/GOT support without disabling protections. No runtime or device assertion was relaxed.

interpretation.fix: The Linux vfork child now enumerates actual fds through raw openat/getdents64/fcntl/close into a fixed stack buffer. No heap allocator, directory stream, locks, sysconf or numerical FD cap; native close_range still takes precedence. Failures propagate before exec.
interpretation.directComparison: The previous 4 KiB matrix had 18 failing lowered-limit observations and Samsung had 2. All 24 current lowered-limit observations pass, including previous native x86_64/Samsung controls; both spawn APIs reject inheritance while parent descriptors and original limits are preserved.
interpretation.highFdBoundary: The exact helper passes native Linux vfork/exec with FD 70000, soft and hard lowered limits and old-loop failing controls. Android uses the same FD 256 fixture and hard limit 32768; this is not Android FD 70000 or hard-limit-lowering execution evidence.
interpretation.nativeSixteenKiBBoundary: The new runtime bytes passed the complete 20-probe test-only application suite twice on native ARM64 16 KiB. This is not experimental plugin Binder acceptance, native x86_64 16 KiB support, or a signed Release-APK result.
interpretation.buildGate: Build-input-only verification does not accept runtime evidence. Default acceptance requires the new two-build and corresponding-source binding; neither historical six-patch nor seven-patch evidence can satisfy this source gate.
noOverclaim: Not a security sandbox or supervision of arbitrary detached descendants.
CLOSE_RANGE_UNSHARE, other syscall fallbacks, watch/reload, all-thread semantics and blocked asynchronous spawn remain separate gates.
API 29/30/32 application evidence, full experimental Binder, stable Android 9 support and matching experimental APK/source publication remain open.
Official runtime bytes, minimum API, production signing, v0.2.0 assets and tags are unchanged.
